positive_terms: Disclosure of extent and indication of nature of cases of non-respect of the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work or OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises that involve value chain workers
价值链中未遵守国际人权与劳工文书的案例
披露涉及价值链劳动者的、未遵守联合国商业与人权指导原则、ILO基本原则和权利宣言或OECD跨国企业准则的案例性质与范围。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
